parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The Agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. It is automatically generated during the Agent registration process. During API registration and query processes, this ID must be carried throughout. Call the ListAtiAgentRegisterInfos operation to query the target Agent and obtain the AgentRegisterInfoId from the response
parameters.help_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册、查询流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，需调用接口 ListAtiAgentRegisterInfos 查询目标Agent后从应答内容获取AgentRegisterInfoId
parameters.name: agent_register_info_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This field is returned only when RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

AuthAction.description_en: The unauthorized operation that was attempted
AuthAction.description_zh: 尝试执行的未授权操作

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authorization principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The owner ID of the authorization principal

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 加密后的完整诊断信息

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The reason for the authentication failure. Valid values:
ExplicitDeny: explicit deny.
ImplicitDeny: implicit deny
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
导致鉴权失败的原因。具体取值为：
ExplicitDeny：显示拒绝
ImplicitDeny：隐式拒绝

AgentRegisterInfoId.description_en: The Agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform
AgentRegisterInfoId.description_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性

AllVerified.description_en: Indicates whether all DNS records have been verified
AllVerified.description_zh: 是否全部DNS记录都完成验证

RecordType.description_en: The DNS type of the record, such as TLSA or TXT

VerifyStatus.description_en:
The DNS record verification status. Valid values:
Verified
Not verified
You must configure the generated DNS records under the corresponding domain name. DNS record verification must be completed to activate the Agent. DNS record verification ensures that other Agents can discover the current Agent through DNS resolution
VerifyStatus.description_zh:
DNS记录验证状态，包含：
已验证
未验证
用户需将生成的DNS记录配置到对应域名下，完成DNS记录验证才可激活Agent。DNS记录验证确保其它Agent可以通过DNS解析发现当前Agent

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation to delete the domain name instance configuration is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
删除域名实例配置操作是否成功：

true：操作成功

false：操作失败
